Ch153 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 153)

Subject: evolution | ID: 153001

Corollary

For every rational mapping \(f\) on a Hilbert space \(X\), there exists a stack structure \(\mathcal{S}\) such that the theorem is established \(\|T_f\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C \cdot \|f\|_{L^2}\).

Proof

Step 1. Consider the Hilbert-Schmidt operator \(T_{1530011}\) acting on the non-separable space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the singular value decomposition, we obtain \(\|T_{1530011}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1530011}\).

Step 2. Consider the Schauder operator \(T_{1530012}\) acting on the integrable space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the QR decomposition, we obtain \(\|T_{1530012}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1530012}\).

Step 3. Consider the Laplacian operator \(T_{1530013}\) acting on the Banach space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the LU decomposition, we obtain \(\|T_{1530013}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1530013}\).

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via injective interpolation, the theorem is established with constant \(C = C_{1530011} \cdot C_{1530012} \cdot C_{1530013}\).
